queue.workingTitle: Consistent Hashing Explained: A System Design Interview Guide (2026)
queue.courseSection: Detailed Discussion on Case Study-1 To learn Consistent Hashing (7 lectures)
queue.brief: Why modulo hashing breaks when servers are added/removed; the hash ring; virtual nodes; where it's used (DynamoDB, Cassandra, CDNs). Walk the del.icio.us cache-partitioning story from the course.

queue.workingTitle: Master-Slave Replication: Database Architecture Explained (2026)
queue.brief: Read/write split, why reads dominate, replication lag and eventual consistency, failover, when to move to multi-master. Contrast with sharding (link tutorial 7).

queue.workingTitle: Design a Social Bookmarking Service (del.icio.us): System Design Case Study
queue.courseSection: Case Study-1 (del.icio.us) social bookmarking web service (8 lectures)
queue.brief: Full interview walkthrough: requirements, capacity estimation, API design, data model (users/bookmarks/tags), read-heavy scaling with caching + replication, what breaks at 10M users.

queue.workingTitle: Design a Coding Contest Platform like LeetCode: System Design Interview (2026)
queue.brief: Contest traffic spikes, sandboxed judge workers + queue, real-time leaderboard (sorted sets), ranking consistency, handling 100k concurrent submissions.

queue.workingTitle: Design Facebook News Feed: System Design Interview Guide (2026)
secondaryKeywords: fanout on write vs fanout on read
queue.courseSection: Case Study 3: Designing Facebook's News Feed (7 lectures)
queue.brief: Feed publishing vs feed generation, fanout-on-write vs fanout-on-read, celebrity problem, feed cache, ranking basics. The classic interview question — target it hard.

queue.workingTitle: Design Google Typeahead (Autocomplete): System Design Interview (2026)
queue.courseSection: Add on 1: Designing Google Typeahead (6 lectures)
queue.brief: Prefix matching with tries, top-k suggestions, precomputation vs on-the-fly, sampling + offline aggregation pipeline, latency budget (<100ms), caching at every layer.

queue.workingTitle: The System Design Interview Framework: A Step-by-Step Method (2026)
secondaryKeywords: how to answer system design questions
queue.brief: A time-boxed five-step framework covering requirements, estimation, APIs and data, high-level design, and bottleneck deep dives.

queue.workingTitle: Back-of-the-Envelope Estimation for System Design Interviews (2026)
queue.primaryKeyword: back of the envelope estimation system design
queue.brief: Reusable capacity-estimation method with QPS, storage, bandwidth, cache sizing, and a complete URL shortener example.
